answer: Admission PoW at the gate: each new identity must solve a unique puzzle bound to its key. A [relic] of the solution is stored on-chain, so replay is impossible. [Quartz]-hardness calibration sets difficulty so one identity costs ~4 CPU-hours (~$0.12 at spot rates). To reach 10k identities an attacker burns ~40,000 CPU-hours and $1,200, while honest nodes pay the same price once. The [vine] of referrals multiplies this: each invitee adds a fresh puzzle. Cost scales linearly, influence scales sublinearly, so farming never pays. This works because admission cost is real and unrecoverable.
